# petstore

Swagger Petstore

## Install

Homebrew 6 requires third-party taps to be trusted before first install:

```sh
brew tap --trust oxmonty/tap
brew install oxmonty/tap/petstore-cli
```

Installing with the fully-qualified form (`brew install oxmonty/tap/petstore-cli`) skips the trust prompt.

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oxmonty/petstore-cli/main/install.sh | sh
```

From source:

```sh
go install github.com/oxmonty/petstore-cli/cmd/petstore@latest
```

## Usage

```sh
petstore --help
petstore pets create
```

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning |
| ---- | ------- |
| 0 | Success |
| 1 | Internal error |
| 2 | Usage error (bad flags/arguments) |
| 3 | Auth failure (HTTP 401/403) |
| 4 | Other 4xx API error |
| 5 | 5xx API error |
| 6 | Network/transport error |

## Upgrade

```sh
petstore upgrade
```

## Shell completions

```sh
petstore completion bash|zsh|fish|powershell
```
